note: Entity Class Formatter is a single field formatter (id entity_class_formatter, label 'Entity Class') plus one hook_entity_view_alter(). The formatter's viewElements() returns an empty array; the hook copies the field's values onto $build['#attributes'][<attr>] of the rendered entity. Settings are prefix, suffix, attr (default 'class') and field (entity-reference only); attr is required in the UI for decimal/float/integer fields. Supported field types: boolean, decimal, entity_reference, float, integer, list_string, string. There is no settings form and no configure route - all state is the component in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>. Every medium/hard case therefore reads or writes that real view-display component on node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I want the value of a node field to end up as a CSS class on the rendered node's wrapper element, without the field itself being printed. The entity_class_formatter contrib module is installed. What do I configure, and what is the machine name of the formatter?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage display page choose the 'Entity Class' format (formatter id entity_class_formatter) for that field. The formatter renders nothing; the module's hook_entity_view_alter() appends the field's values to $build['#attributes']['class'] of the entity, so the class shows up on the entity wrapper. The choice is stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<view_mode> under content.<field>.type.

evals.prompt: What settings does the Drupal entity_class_formatter field formatter expose, and which one do I use to write the field value into a data-* attribute instead of the class attribute? Are there field types where that setting is mandatory?
evals.expected_output: Four settings: prefix, suffix, attr and field. 'attr' is the attribute name to use instead of 'class' (e.g. data-variant) and it is #required in the settings form for decimal, float and integer fields. 'prefix'/'suffix' are concatenated around each value. 'field' only appears for entity_reference fields and names a field on the referenced entity to read instead of its label.

evals.prompt: Which field types can the Drupal entity_class_formatter formatter be used on, and what value does it contribute for an entity reference field and for a boolean field?
evals.expected_output: Supported field types are boolean, decimal, entity_reference, float, integer, list_string and string. For an entity_reference field it uses each referenced entity's label(), unless the 'field' setting names a field on the referenced entity, in which case it recurses into that field's values. For a boolean field it uses the field definition's on_label when the value is truthy and off_label otherwise. Plain values are split on spaces into several classes when the target attribute is 'class'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a field named field_ecf_known that is rendered with the Entity Class formatter from the entity_class_formatter module. Inspect the live default view display for Article and tell me the exact prefix and suffix configured for that formatter.
evals.expected_output: prefix is 'ecfx-' and suffix is '-tone': in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecf_known component has type entity_class_formatter with settings.prefix = 'ecfx-' and settings.suffix = '-tone'.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site's Article content type has two string fields, field_ecf_attr and field_ecf_plain. One of them is configured with the entity_class_formatter module to write its value into a custom HTML attribute instead of a CSS class. Inspect the live view display configuration and tell me which field it is and the exact attribute name it writes to.
evals.expected_output: field_ecf_attr. In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component uses type entity_class_formatter with settings.attr = 'data-ecf-variant'; field_ecf_plain uses the ordinary 'string' formatter.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the entity_class_formatter module installed and the Article content type has a text field field_ecf_task. Configure the default view display for Article so that this field's value is added as a CSS class on the rendered article (and is not printed as text), with every generated class prefixed with 'palette-'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecf_task component must have type: entity_class_formatter with settings.prefix = 'palette-' and settings.attr left empty (so values go into the class attribute).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this Drupal site has an integer field field_ecf_cols. Using the entity_class_formatter module, make the rendered article carry the field's value in an HTML attribute named data-ecf-columns instead of printing the number. Apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ecf_cols component must have type: entity_class_formatter with settings.attr = 'data-ecf-columns'. (The attr setting is required for integer fields, which is why an empty attr is not acceptable here.)
